method: PLAYBOOK + QUEUE + research-cycle-3.json; R3 ship-without-input drained on origin/main through #353 (filter docs #352, conflict reapply #353, anon markup #351, field delta #350; mcp query_osm PR #354 in flight). Open issues still only #162/#183. Validated R3 leftovers still open in code (offline-sync lacks checkOnly; connecting-postgis.md still claims Phase 1.5 SRID/WHERE; markup-panel promotes but no GeoJSON download; DuckDB Analyze refuses meter buffers while derived_layer buffer recipe exists). New gap: Android OfflineDownloader still full-fetches after portal-web #350. Ethos filters applied; needs-maintainer carry-forward unchanged.

proposals.title: Field push uses checkOnly before transferring edits
proposals.summary: API checkOnly on feature PATCH/DELETE already validates baseObservationId without writing (#329). portal-web offline-sync still posts full edits first and only learns about 409s after transfer. A cheap dry-run pass surfaces stale rows before bytes move, matching Mergin's check_only pattern and pairing with the field delta pull shipped in #350.
proposals.rationale: Highest-leverage unfinished Mergin honesty slice after delta pull. Improves field reliability without UI invention; can ship as a thin follow-up to #350.
proposals.risk: Extra round-trips on huge queues. Batch checkOnly per layer and skip when baseObservationId is absent (create-only).
proposals.ethosFit: Field reliability on your hardware. Recoverable sync before silent overwrite.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Before applying a queued update/delete, call the same path with checkOnly=true; on 409 record the conflict artifact path and mark the edit rejected with the server reason; then proceed with real writes for the rest; extend offline-sync specs.

proposals.title: PostGIS help catch-up plus guided table picker on connect
proposals.summary: connecting-postgis.md still says SRID reprojection and visual WHERE are Phase 1.5 coming next, but the API already reprojects non-4326 and FilterEditor compiles MapLayer.filter on the map layer panel. Meanwhile PostgisConnectionBuilder saves after a version-only test-connection with no table preview. Refresh help for honesty and extend test-connection (or a follow-up probe) to return a capped geometry-table inventory so authors see what will register before Save.
proposals.rationale: Docs honesty is playbook-required; schema browser Phase 2 is the cheap UX bridge on an API that already inventories geometry_columns.
proposals.risk: Large schemas can overwhelm the UI. Cap listed tables, show geometry tables only, and keep Save registering the same set the probe already uses.
proposals.ethosFit: Prefer PostGIS live-read over copying data into SaaS. Guided connection before raw connection strings.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Update connecting-postgis.md Limitations to match shipped SRID/filter behavior; extend test-connection to return table inventory (name, SRID, row estimate); render a read-only capped table list in PostgisConnectionBuilder before Save.

proposals.title: Export a markup set as GeoJSON from the panel
proposals.summary: Roadmap success criteria for drawings include a direct GeoJSON export link. Promote already copies to a data_layer (#330); anonymous markup shipped (#351). A Download GeoJSON action on a set (author or map editor) is a one-afternoon honesty win for handoff to QGIS without promote.
proposals.rationale: Open formats out; reviewers should leave with standards-shaped files, not screenshots or network-tab scrapes.
proposals.risk: Low. Cap feature count already enforced by DRAWING_LIMITS; no new write path. Prefer client-side blob from the loaded set unless a stable URL is needed for agents.
proposals.ethosFit: Open file formats throughout. Guided export before asking users to scrape the network tab.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add Download control on MarkupPanel that builds a FeatureCollection blob from the loaded set (or GET .../drawings/:id.geojson); mention in markup help + What's new.

proposals.title: Guided Buffer shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: DuckDB Analyze correctly refuses meter buffers without PROJ in WASM. Server-side buffer tool and derived-layer builder already exist. Add a one-click Buffer this layer control on the data-layer Analyze or layer page that opens a guided distance/unit form and creates a derived_layer buffer recipe instead of lying in the browser.
proposals.rationale: Wherever Esri meters buffer work, ship free on PostGIS. Guided parameters over raw recipe JSON. Closes the analysis honesty gap called out in the spatial-analysis workbench research.
proposals.risk: Users may expect instant in-browser results. Label clearly as a server derived layer job and link to analysis tier availability.
proposals.ethosFit: Free-at-point-of-use analysis on your hardware. Prefer PostGIS buffer over proprietary Spatial Analyst seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add Buffer action that POSTs a single-step buffer derived_layer from the current layer id with guided meters/feet distance; reuse existing worker path; help + What's new.

proposals.title: Wire Android offline refresh to layer delta?since=N
proposals.summary: portal-web offline refresh now uses GET .../delta?since=N (#350). Android OfflineDownloader still resolves layers and re-fetches full feature payloads on every take-offline / refresh, with no syncVersion cursor on OfflinePackageEntity. Persist syncVersion per layer package and refresh via the same delta endpoint (full geojson only on first package or unknown cursor).
proposals.rationale: Keeps the field Android client honest with the Mergin-shaped sync story already paid for on the API and PWA. Without it, mobile crews keep paying O(n) after the web path stopped.
proposals.risk: Delta semantics must honor deletes and share geo/row scope the same as features; corrupt or missing cursors need a full-resync fallback. Mirror portal-web offline-download behavior rather than inventing a third dialect.
proposals.ethosFit: Hardens the field Android app on open PostGIS data the portal already owns. Beats seat-metered Field Maps sync cost without a new pillar.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add syncVersion on OfflinePackageEntity / LayerEntity; on refresh call delta?since=N through PortalClient; apply upserts/deletes; on 410/unknown cursor fall back to full geojson once; unit-test the apply path.

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n readiness on form designer chrome
proposals.summary: After terrain (#335), chrome sweep (#346), tile-layer errors (#348), and comments/markup chrome on the smart-upload branch, keep extracting bounded hard-coded strings. Next surface: form designer chrome (actions row, import warnings, expression builder labels) into catalogs with t() calls. No Weblate, no RTL, no locale product choice.
proposals.rationale: Only two open issues; #162 remains the finishable cross-cutting slice playbook already prioritizes.
proposals.risk: Catalog churn across five locales. Keep the PR to one surface area; machine-translate non-en with the existing Phase 1.1 pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Mechanical readiness for the self-hosted EU/LATAM demo audience. No localization SaaS decision.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Extract form designer chrome strings (actions row, import banners, expression builder) into en/es/fr/de/pt-BR catalogs with t() calls.
